title: Proof
description: How we know: a proof question, the tests that help answer it and their results on each build, and the rules and actions a principle rests on, read in from the code by npm run principles.

types.title: Proof
types.description: Something a user would ask before trusting the software, such as how we know the sun is correct. The title is the question. It is answered on a build when every test of it passed there: that is worked out from the results, not stored.

types.title: Test
types.description: One check that helps answer a proof question. A draft is a test that is wanted and not yet written. What it found is kept per build, as test results.

compares.description: What is compared with what, in one line a user can read: the position of the sun against the NOAA calculator in six cities.

tolerance.description: How close it must be to pass, e.g. within 0.01 degrees.

environment.description: Where it runs and draws its picture: outside any host, or inside the program it extends.

key.description: Where it lives in the code, for one read in by npm run principles: its file and its name.

digest.description: A hash of what npm run principles last read of it, so it is changed only when the code is.

types.title: Test result
types.description: What one test found on one build. There is one for each test on each build; a later run on the same build replaces it.

evidence.description: Where the proof is: a path, URL or commit.

build.description: The version or commit the test ran on.

picture.description: Where the picture the test drew is: a path in the repository it ran in, under its .proof folder, which git ignores. The file itself is sent to Archipelago (picture_put) only when the result is shown in public.

types.title: Rule
types.description: A rule a pack keeps as data: when a change applies, waits for a person or is refused, or what a reply is asked. Read in from the pack file by npm run principles, never typed; it serves the principles it upholds.

key.description: Where it lives: its pack and its id, as core/forget.

then.description: What it does when it matches: hold, refuse, apply, or what it asks of a reply.

lifted.description: The workspace setting that lifts it, when its pack lets one.

digest.description: A hash of what npm run principles last read of it.

types.title: Agent action
types.description: One thing an agent can do, called under one of the six verbs: the kernel's own or a pack's. Read in from the code by npm run principles, never typed; it serves the principles it upholds.

key.description: Its verb and name, as report/tell.

verb.description: The verb it is called under.

pack.description: The pack that declares it, or kernel.

digest.description: A hash of what npm run principles last read of it.

links.title: helps answer
links.description: The test is part of how we know. A proof question is answered on a build when every test that helps answer it passed there.
